What might your dog be saying?

Tap a moment for a quick, low-pressure read. Then check the whole body before you act.

A tail is only one clue. Feelings show up in patterns, movement, and the freedom to choose.

A softer read

Loose usually means comfortable.

A relaxed dog can still be alert or excited. Look for easy movement and the ability to choose what happens next.

  • What you might seeSoft eyes, a wiggly middle, and a mouth that rests open or gently closed.
  • Check with itCan the dog sniff, blink, eat, move away, or choose to pause?
  • What it may meanIn this context, the combination is more consistent with comfort.
  • Don’t assumeA wag only tells you the tail is moving—not whether the feeling is happy.
  • Kind responseKeep the moment predictable and let the dog choose what happens next.
  • Get support ifThe change is sudden, persistent, painful, or paired with a safety concern.
WagSignals ✦

Educational guidance, not a diagnosis. Read the whole dog and make space when you are unsure.
